title: A Monster Calls
author: Patrick Ness
summary: Thirteen-year-old Conor is visited each night by a yew-tree monster who tells him three stories and demands a fourth, his own truth. Meanwhile, his mother is seriously ill and he is bullied at school.
readIf: you want a short, moving story about grief and honesty that suits teens and adults.
skipIf: you are not ready for a story about a parent's terminal illness.
